mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals stronger economic demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 rises above 11703.6 but 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly UNRATE below 4.0% indicates tightening labor markets, reducing wage growth expectations and prompting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when UNRATE crosses below 4.0% but 20d returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly INDPRO above historical thresholds signal robust demand and supply growth, amplifying equity valuations and driving S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO exceeding thresholds in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, high quarterly GDP (GDPC1) coupled with low CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL < 215.0) signals peak growth nears, prompting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in late-cycle expansions where GDPC1 > 12000 and CPIAUCSL < 215.0 but 60d returns are not significantly positive.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicate easing monetary policy and robust demand, creating a positive feedback loop that drives S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when FEDFUNDS > 2.0 and GDPC1 > 11703.6 but 20d returns are not statistically positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly UNRATE above 5.5% signals labor market tightness, reducing wage growth expectations and prompting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when UNRATE crosses above 5.5% but 5d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly INDPRO above historical levels indicates stronger production capacity, boosting corporate profits and driving S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite INDPRO rising above 110.9051 in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery periods, falling UNRATE below 4.0% combined with rising FEDFUNDS signals labor market tightening and monetary easing, driving S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in post-shock recovery periods where UNRATE < 4.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0 but 20d returns are not statistically positive.
